comments.text: Being the daughter of a WW II veteran, I am beyond touched by this masterpiece.  The humanity is truly heart-wrenching and brings me to tears throughout the series.  So brave, and so young. I'm honored to have my father's legacy to carry on the best I can.  This is by far the best war series I've ever experienced.

comments.author: @cascastro
comments.text: I’ve experienced “Band of Brothers” several times, and I say experienced rather than watched because it is an emotional and visceral miniseries that benefits from multiple viewings and taking the time to evaluate what it is one has just seen. As a veteran from a later time I can relate in some small way to what the men of Easy Company went through. They represent what many men and women endured throughout the Second World War and I salute them all. This miniseries is a monument to all those who lived and died during that turbulent period in our history.

comments.author: @DustinBlaise
comments.text: hands down one of, if not THE, best shows ever made. One of the few shows that I have re-watched 10+ times. Incredible stories, great choices of actors that matches the men they represent both how they look and act and amazing use of practical and special effects. Has many moments that still to this day makes my adrenaline pump, laugh or makes me shed tears. If you have fascination of WW2 History like myself, this is definitely a must watch.
